task_description: Write a method in Dafny to find the pairwise addition of the neighboring elements of the given sequence.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method PairwiseAddNeighbors(seq: seq<int>) returns (result: seq<int>)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The result sequence contains the sums of each pair of neighboring elements in the input sequence
    - The length of the result sequence is either equal to the length of the input sequence minus one, or zero if the input sequence has fewer than two elements
